name: MME
intro: MME是一个针对多模态大型语言模型的综合性评估基准。它旨在衡量模型在14个子任务上的感知和认知能力，包括存在、计数、位置、颜色、海报、名人、场景、地标、艺术品、OCR、常识推理、数值计算、文本翻译和代码推理。为避免数据泄漏，所有指令-答案对均由人工设计。
org: Nanjing University, Tencent Youtu Lab, Xiamen University, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA)
build_method: COCO与公开识别/OCR图像抽样、人工照片或扩散图像、全量人工成对是非问答标注
metric: 每题ACC、每图两题均对的ACC+；子任务100×(ACC+ACC+)，感知满分2,000、认知满分800
eval_feature: 严格四字段两行评分输入、yes/no精确或前四字符解析、格式错误整包中止、other保留在ACC/ACC+分母、分母取决于实际输入行
build_method_en: COCO and public recognition/OCR image sampling, manual photographs or diffusion images, and fully human-authored paired yes/no QA
eval_feature_en: Strict four-field/two-row scorer input, exact-or-first-four-character yes/no parsing, whole-run abort on malformed input, other retained in ACC/ACC+ denominators, and denominators derived from supplied rows
intro_en: MME is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models. It aims to assess models' perceptual and cognitive abilities across 14 subtasks, including existence, counting, location, color, posters, celebrities, scenes, landmarks, artworks, OCR, commonsense reasoning, numerical calculation, text translation, and code reasoning. To prevent data leakage, all instruction-answer pairs are manually designed.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source audit pins original arXiv:2306.13394v1 (PDF SHA-256 f7c0b5dc45ee2b5021f7138dd3f9ed6308c34d663fbc015cea57cf8b58555d9d), latest v5 (PDF SHA-256 19fa0612fc8668707e2085ee1df8c5b5ae99818e156023a609c521deea3b4626), the first official Evaluation-branch MME commit 04eb8401039f5216233317fe87e6317368d6eefc, official score-tool commit 1c1d69e138b57cf8b0400427927bfb8ed4285458 and zip SHA-256 b8125e2a7c3418e5761c12b3cfe4f1624b3c53ba44009e75b7d3f797d3d8acee, and public Hugging Face snapshot 7056f44dac19de35e510b62d734bb2f7a6f64739. The canonical paper URL is locked to v1 because the diagram's construction and original score-tool contract are anchored to that release; v5 is retained only as a revision boundary whose core suite and metrics are unchanged. The paper-backed suite has 14 subtasks: COCO supplies 30 images each for existence/count/color/position (120); public recognition sets supply poster 147, celebrity 170, and scene/landmark/artwork 200 each (917); OCR supplies 20 relatively simple images; commonsense uses 70 manual photographs or diffusion images; and numerical/translation/code use 20 manual photographs each (60). Source annotations are not directly reused or relied upon, and every QA is manually written. Each of 1,187 images receives two concise zero-shot questions ending with 'Please answer yes or no': the first ground-truth yes and the second no, yielding 2,374 instruction-answer pairs. ACC is per question; ACC+ requires both rows for an image; random baselines are 50%/25%; each subtask score is 100×(ACC+ACC+) with full score 200; perception/cognition totals are 2,000/800. The official scorer chunks every two supplied lines, asserts exactly two rows per chunk, unpacks exactly four tab fields, lowercases the response, accepts exact yes/no or searches only the first four characters with yes checked before no, treats other as wrong while retaining it in ACC/ACC+ denominators but excluding it from precision/recall/confusion counts, and aborts the whole run on malformed or odd input rather than skipping/imputing rows. It does not validate expected per-task row counts or same-image pairing, so a completely omitted two-row pair silently shrinks the denominator. Access drift is explicit: v1 required email application, while the audited 2024 public snapshot contains exactly 2,374 rows with question_id/image/question/answer/category and no per-row source/license field. Undisclosed annotator, selection, rejection, deduplication, contamination, and rights-mapping details remain gaps. EN/ZH specs have identical IDs, types, positions, and edges. Strict generation and normalization passed; formal Draw.io, architecture sidecars, fixed-light SVGs, and Desktop PNG exports were regenerated and visually verified in both languages without clipping, overlap, or rendering artifacts. Formal publication evidence [site-a11n-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2393×1081 (English) and 2381×1081 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2391×1079 and 2379×1079. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
